title: A complete promised-class companion retains its prohibitive normalizer budget
statement: For V(x)=x^T Hx/2-sum a_j logcosh(v_j^T x), H positive definite,a_j>=0 and ZERO hidden biases, supplied Hmax/Q4 and precision-controlled scalar potential oracle earn H0=H-sum a_jv_jv_j^T=HessV(0) as GLOBAL lower Hessian. Gaussian-read precision R makes EVERY posterior eta-strongly convex iff H0+R>=etaI. D=(etaI-H0)_+ gives exact minimal unit-power read count max(rankD,ceil(sigma^2 trD)), or 0 if D=0, via classical frame completion. n^2+n+1 scalar values under supplied fourth-derivative/error bounds acquire guarded certificate; finite matching values do not prove class promise. Source-reported 6D case: 43 calibrations / 3 reads beats uniform-coordinate sufficient 12 reads, while EQUALLY INFORMED ordinary spectral design ties exactly. Elementary normalization closure costs~3.68e28 scalar values even 2D toy, NOT EXECUTED; established Ge–Lee–Lu stronger methods and unknown prior normalizer remain. Oracleprecision/inputcost, condition numbers, calibration and dense controls must be paid; no general efficient representation discovery or speed advantage.

No hidden features,Hessian,gradient,prior sampler or prior normalizer supplied. Finite calibration gives global certificate only using the class promise/fourth-derivative bound; numerical matching alone does not prove membership.

Fresh-state unit-power linear reads with independent Gaussian variance sigma^2; fixed positive target curvature eta,actual frame implementation and all dense/precision costs. Polynomial oracle count is not unrestricted bit complexity.

r=64 synthetic calibration pays 2,080 scalar calls with absolute error 1e-7, 4,326,400 feature entries, 8,652,800 target products and 16,640-byte prepared model; deployment 65 reads and 2,080 dense aggregate products.
